// Every layout element and feature, for the golden test. Not compiled by
// itself: test/golden_test.dart reads it with the DSL in memory.

class IconData {
  final int codePoint;
  final String? fontFamily;
  const IconData(this.codePoint, {this.fontFamily});
}

class Icons {
  static const favorite = IconData(0xe25b, fontFamily: 'MaterialIcons');
  static const star = IconData(0xe5f9, fontFamily: 'MaterialIcons');
}

@HomeScreenWidget(
  displayName: 'Dashboard',
  description: 'Everything at once',
  sizes: [NWSize.small, NWSize.medium, NWSize.circular, NWSize.inline],
  fields: [
    NWField.integer('count'),
    NWField.decimal('progress', initial: '0.4'),
    NWField.boolean('on'),
    NWField.dateTime('due'),
    NWField.image('photo'),
    NWField.string('title', repeat: 3),
  ],
  layout: NWColumn(
    crossAxisAlignment: NWCrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
    mainAxisAlignment: NWMainAxisAlignment.spaceBetween,
    spacing: 4,
    children: [
      NWRow(spacing: 6, children: [
        NWIcon(Icons.favorite, size: 16, color: NWColor('#E91E63')),
        NWText('Count {count}', maxLines: 1,
            style: NWTextStyle(size: 13, font: 'assets/fonts/Brand.ttf')),
        NWSpacer(),
        NWClock(style: NWTextStyle(size: 13)),
      ]),
      NWRichText([
        NWSpan('{count}', size: 24, weight: NWFontWeight.bold),
        NWSpan(' items', color: NWColor.secondaryLabel),
      ]),
      NWStack(children: [
        NWProgress.circular(field: 'progress', size: 48, thickness: 6),
        NWIcon(Icons.star, size: 14),
      ]),
      NWProgress(field: 'progress', trackColor: NWColor('#22000000')),
      NWBox(
        expand: true,
        radius: 8,
        gradient: NWGradient(colors: [NWColor('#1E3A8A'), NWColor('#7C3AED')]),
        child: NWImage(field: 'photo'),
      ),
      NWIf(
        condition: NWCondition.isTrue('on'),
        child: NWTimer(field: 'due'),
        orElse: NWDateText(field: 'due', pattern: 'd MMM'),
      ),
      NWButton(
        action: NWAction.increment('count', max: 9),
        child: NWText('+'),
      ),
      NWList(
        count: 3,
        spacing: 2,
        child: NWButton(
          action: NWAction.toggle('on'),
          child: NWText('{title#}'),
        ),
      ),
    ],
  ),
  circularLayout: NWAnalogClock(size: 60),
  inlineLayout: NWText('{count} items'),
)
class Dashboard {}

@HomeScreenWidget(
  sizes: [NWSize.small],
  fields: [NWField.string('temp', initial: '--')],
  options: [NWOption('city', label: 'City', choices: ['Cairo', 'Giza'])],
  refresh: NWRefresh(
    url: 'https://example.com/weather?q={city}',
    values: {'temp': 'current.temp'},
    headers: {'Accept': 'application/json'},
  ),
  layout: NWText('{city} {temp}'),
)
class Weather {}

@WidgetCallback(widget: 'Dashboard')
Future<void> onDashboard(Object event) async {}
